name: ai-search-sov-monitor
description: Monitors brand citations, recommendation rank, source domain attribution, and share-of-voice across AI search engines (Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, ChatGPT, Grok, Groq). Syncs long-term trend timeline databases to Notion and sends Slack alerts via MCP connectors.
author: Abhishek Khanra (ishekofficial)
